# Compute friend emails set
friend_emails = {f['email'] for f in friends}

# Determine who to add and who to remove
to_add = sender_emails - friend_emails
to_remove = friend_emails - sender_emails

print("To add:", to_add)
print("To remove:", to_remove)

# Add friends (senders not already friends)
for email in to_add:
    result = apis.venmo.add_friend(access_token=access_token, user_email=email)
    print(f"Add {email}: {result}")

# Remove friends (current friends not in sender list)
for email in to_remove:
    result = apis.venmo.remove_friend(access_token=access_token, user_email=email)
    print(f"Remove {email}: {result}")
